description:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

If you love working with brilliant people, being part of an energetic team, changing the world of software and you’ve got the technical skills, you might be the perfect Frog to join our Swamp! Come and help us to continue to lead the rapidly evolving space of DevSecOps!

As a Professional Services DevOps Architect in JFrog you will...

  • Guide the DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps journeys of JFrog’s most strategic customers, positing yourself as their trusted advisor
  • Work with JFrog customers to consult, architect, design and implement CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps platform using JFrog products and other cutting edge technologies and practices like Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and Cloud Native
  • Team up with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support and Development while work directly with Devs and DevSecOps Pros to ensure success with the customer’s DevSecOps journey using the JFrog platform
  • Mentor and coach members of the consulting team
  • Train the open source community and JFrog customers
  • Influence the features and roadmap of JFrog tools based on customer needs
  • Keep current with the latest technology trends related to DevSecOps and the landscape of CI/CD Technology
  • Work closely with our customers and community to build solid relationships

To be a Professional Services DevOps Architect in JFrog you need...

  • 15+ years of professional experience and 5+ years of experience working in professional services or consulting with enterprise customers
  • Experience with Continuous Integration tools: CI Server, Git, Artifactory, Jenkins, Maven, Docker, NPM
  • Ability to lead, architect and build software delivery pipelines with Docker, npm, Java, Pypi etc.. using various DevSecOps tools such as Git, Binary repositories management, Binary scanning, and Continuous integration
  • Good understanding of infrastructure & operations - storage, network, computer, security, cloud (public, on-prem)
  • Experience with Continuous Deployment and Delivery tools: Terraform, , Ansible, ArgoCD, Kubernetes
  • Hands on experience in Linux - Mandatory
  • Hands on experience with cloud infrastructure - AWS / Azure / GCP - Mandatory
  • Experience with customer facing with great interpersonal and customer service oriented skills
  • Experience with server side software on-premise and in the cloud
  • Experience with Software Architecture design and product development a plus
  • Experience with MLOps toolset & ecosystem is a plus
  • Uncompromising will to learn
  • Open Source state-of-mind

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

  • At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.
  • This position has a base salary range between $$200,000 to $225,000  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.
  • Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.
  • This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
  • JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!
  • This position may offer future development opportunity into a leadership role within our team.

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.
